result.summary: Found one visible layout defect: the delivery-time and delivery-fee text overlaps on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, making both illegible. The rest of the page renders cleanly. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom are intentional scroll affordances and were not reported.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery-time text ('25–35 min') and the delivery-fee text ('€0 delivery') are rendered on top of each other in the same line, producing garbled, unreadable text.
issues.suggestion: Give the delivery time and delivery fee separate lines or flex containers, or allow the metadata row to wrap, so the two strings never occupy the same space. Verify the fix at narrow viewport widths.
